outcome: isthmocele (diagnosed by TVUS, MRI, and/or DxHys)
cohort: The study included 90 women with a previous history of cesarean section.
finding: A high prevalence of isthmocele (63.3%) was found, and higher BMI during delivery, longer interdelivery interval, and more than two cesarean sections were identified as risk factors for its presence.
mod_finding: The presence of more than two cesarean sections was identified as a risk factor for isthmocele.
